name: Heatmap
usage: Activity by weekday and hour, change compared with a target by team and month (diverging)

props.name: data
props.description: The cells; a cell whose `x` or `y` is not a category, or whose value is missing, is not drawn.

props.name: scale
props.description:
`sequential`: one hue from the smallest to the largest value (magnitude); `diverging`: two opposite hues on
both sides of `midpoint`, gray at the midpoint (above or below a baseline).

props.name: midpoint
props.description: The value of the neutral middle of a diverging scale; the scale is symmetric around it.

props.name: format
props.description: How values are written in the color scale, the tooltip and the table.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Name of the columns: the header of the first column of the table view.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Name of the rows: the header of the second column of the table view.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description:
Name of the values, in the tooltip and as the header of the value column. "Value" by default in the table
(follows `locale`).

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic.

props.name: description
props.description: A short description under the title, such as the period or the unit.

props.name: height
props.description:
Height of the graphic in pixels, axis labels included. The states take the same height. The table view starts at
this height and grows with its rows up to 480 px (or this height when it is taller); only longer tables scroll.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Loading: without data, a delayed loading indicator takes the place of the graphic; with data, the previous
graphic stays at reduced opacity until the new data arrives.

props.name: error
props.description: Error: `true` shows the default error state; a node is shown as the message of the error state.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry after an error; shows a "Retry" button in the error state.

props.name: emptyDescription
props.description: Text of the empty state when there is no data, "No data" by default (follows `locale`).

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions in the top-right corner, before the view switch (for example a menu or a time range).

props.name: plain
props.description: Without the card (no background, shadow or padding), for charts inside a Panel, a dialog or a drawer.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value; a missing value draws no cell.

types.name: ValueFormat
types.summary:
How a value is written.
- `'auto'`: in full below 10,000, compact from 10,000 on (1,284 · 12.9K · 4.2M).
- `'number'`: always in full, with grouping separators.
- `'compact'`: always compact.
- `'percent'`: the value is a ratio (0.125 → 12.5%).
- a function: your own formatting (units, currencies).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
A sequential scale for magnitude: lighter is less, darker is more (in dark mode, brighter is more). The color
scale under the cells gives the smallest and largest values.

examples.name: Diverging
examples.title: Diverging
examples.description:
`scale="diverging"` colors values above and below `midpoint` (0 by default) with two opposite hues, and the
midpoint itself in gray.
